scope: four non-isomorphic families, eight OAuth episodes, development only

primary_safety.requirement: no family where TARGET is stale/invalid while BASE is non-stale and admissible

secondary_resolution.endpoint: fully resolved correct paired target minus base
secondary_resolution.promote_to_C_planning: TARGET wins at least 3 of 4 families, loses zero, and all eight executions are admissible
secondary_resolution.hold: TARGET wins exactly 2 of 4 with no safety harm, or manipulation reaches fewer than 3 families
secondary_resolution.reject_behavioural_claim: TARGET wins at most 1 of 4, loses any family, or causes any safety harm

manipulation.endpoint: critical record inspected within the same two-record budget
manipulation.requirement: TARGET exceeds BASE in at least 3 of 4 families

resource_guard.endpoint: total TARGET tokens / total BASE tokens
resource_guard.rationale: 2609.00243 reports a 15 percent contract payload increase; add five percentage points operational tolerance. This is an engineering acceptance guard, not a hypothesis-test threshold.

interpretation: PROMOTE_TO_C_PLANNING never authorizes C; it only permits a separate task/power/quota proposal
